_readme: DigitalCLIQ Inventory Pulse client roster. Hardcoded per Drew, 2026-08-06. Model years are NEVER stored here: the skill resolves current + incoming model year dynamically from live inventory each run. Update platform/notes fields as runs discover them (they are a cache, not a contract). fetch field per dealer: 'server' (urllib works) or 'browser' (WAF'd, needs the in-page JS strategy); probed 2026-08-15.

schedule.note: Runs on the 5th (anchor: month-over-month vs prior month's anchor) and the 20th (pulse: vs this month's anchor).

client_dealer.name: Sterling BMW
client_dealer.notes: Server-fetch 403s; use the Dealer Inspire crawl strategy from compliance-audit memory (browser surfaces cascade). 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: Claude Browser pane (tier1) DEAD all session (navigate failed even on google.com) -> whole run ran on the Chrome extension tier2. Extension exposes 2 browsers and cannot disambiguate unattended: used 'Browser 1' deviceId 4d5c9bfc-44a9-4892-94d3-4dc119f18022. Site labels NEW-vehicle lease offers 'Pre-Owned' in its template (record as published). /finance-specials/ redirects to /lease-finance-offers/ and rendered empty: finance NOT verified. Only dealer with stored VDP urls, so the only one whose delistings are measurable. | 2026-09-20: 13 of 40 re-checked vehicle pages now soft-redirect (HTTP 200) to /used-vehicles/ = confirmed delisted. Lease page would not scroll past the first banner and the Offer Details lightbox never opened, so banners below the fold (X3/3 Series) were missed. X5 lease still served live but its published end date (August 31) has already passed. Real OC Lease Specials URL cached by the agent

competitors.name: Crevier BMW
competitors.notes: Penske store. 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: lease offers are TEXT-rendered homepage banner carousel (not images), disclaimers capturable verbatim. /finance/ read directly, no APR offers = verified_zero for finance. Sitemap sampling: use hyphen-suffixed match tokens (x3-, x5-) to avoid VIN-substring false positives. | 2026-09-20: in-page fetch of /sitemap.xml now returns 403 (WAF tightened since 2026-09-06); the jsfetch bypass is dead here. browser-srp via SNIPPET C worked. Working SRP search/sort param discovered: ?q={term}

competitors.name: Irvine BMW
competitors.notes: Shelly Auto Group. 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: /promotions/new/bmw-promotions.htm rendered EMPTY body twice -> offers unverified, never claim verified_zero. Sitemap mixes static model-landing pages (/new-bmw/330i-irvine-ca.htm) + blog posts that match substring filters: require a VIN in the path (6 of 18 dropped). | 2026-09-20: /promotions/new/bmw-promotions.htm rendered EMPTY for the THIRD run running; homepage banners are vague CTAs with no figures and /finance.htm soft-redirects to generic inventory. Offers remain needs_human_review, never verified_zero. VDP urls use an opaque hash, not the VIN: /new/BMW/{yr}-BMW-{model}-{hash}.htm, so VIN-in-path filtering does not work here

competitors.name: Long Beach BMW
competitors.notes: Domain verified live 2026-08-06. 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: /promotions/new/index.htm renders offer cards as text-on-image banners; headline pmt/term/DAS readable via get_page_text, full disclaimers often NOT reachable (flag disclaimer_not_captured). Sitemap noise: model-landing pages + blogs, require VIN in path (6 of 17 dropped). | 2026-09-20: platform CONFIRMED Dealer.com-family (same as Irvine BMW), not Dealer Inspire. Full verbatim lease disclaimers WERE reachable this run, improving on the prior 'disclaimers often not reachable' note. Finance needs manual review: homepage banner advertises 0.9%/60mo but the detail page was not locatable in the time box

client_dealer.name: McPeek's CDJR of Anaheim
client_dealer.notes: Server-fetchable with Chrome UA. Inventory sitemap https://www.mcpeeks.com/inventory-sitemap.xml, VDP /inventory/display/{cond}/{year}/{make}/{model}/{VIN}. JSON-LD Vehicle on VDPs. Prices arrive as $ entities: html.unescape first. Politeness: max 3 workers, 0.7s pacing (site went down under a 10-worker crawl on 2026-07-26). home+sitemaps 200 (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-06: /specials is an EMPTY STUB and /lease-specials + /specials/{jeep,ram}.htm all redirect to the homepage - this platform has NO dedicated brand/lease specials pages. Real offers live in hidden .slide-disclaimer DOM on the homepage carousel and are PURCHASE DISCOUNTS, not leases (no monthly payment). Server fetch still fine for inventory.

competitors.name: Orange Coast CJDR
competitors.notes: 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) Discovery 2026-08-15: /inventory-sitemap.xml clean per-model; specials are TEXT (not banners) at /new-vehicles/new-specials/; /finance-specials 404s. | 2026-09-06: /inventory-sitemap.xml clean per-model; specials are TEXT at /new-vehicles/new-specials/; /finance-specials 404s. browser-jsfetch ok. | 2026-09-20: sitemap + specials both clean again; /finance-specials still 404s (not re-probed)

competitors.name: Huntington Beach CJDR
competitors.notes: 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) Discovery 2026-08-15: bare '1500' match false-positives on ProMaster 1500 (exclude promaster|fleet-new URLs); specials are banner images at /specials/(brand).htm; floating 'Bad Credit?' CTA masks part of each banner's fine print (note in parse_note). | 2026-09-06: MUST exclude promaster|fleet-new URLs from a bare '1500' match (135 skipped this run). Specials are banner images at /specials/(brand).htm. The 'Bad Credit?' floating CTA was NOT present this run. | 2026-09-20: promaster|fleet-new exclusion held with zero false positives. One sitemap hit was an SRP category page, not a vehicle page: drop non-VIN urls. Pacifica specials page loaded with zero banners = verified_zero

competitors.name: Puente Hills CJDR
competitors.notes: 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) Discovery 2026-08-15: bare '1500' can hit VIN digit coincidences (verify model); real specials page /best-jeep-dodge-chrysler-ram-lease-offers-serving-los-angeles-ca/ (text cards). | 2026-09-06: specials pages (combined + per-brand) use a scroll-lock/lazy-render pattern that blocks reading offers - only 1 of ~4 captured, mark needs_human_review, do NOT claim verified_zero. Use word-boundary '1500' matching to avoid VIN-digit false positives. Site shows an identical $58,085 MSRP across 3 different Pacifica trims (shared-widget artifact, keep as-extracted). | 2026-09-20: NO lazy-render block this run, specials pages loaded fine, but they render as a paginated per-VIN rebate-stack grid rather than $/mo lease banners, so offers stay needs_human_review. MSRP on vehicle pages is unreliable: one Wrangler VIN scraped $53,120 on its page vs $44,990 for the same VIN on the dealer's own specials grid. Pacifica $58,085 duplicate-MSRP artifact reproduced

client_dealer.name: Nissan of Irvine
client_dealer.notes: home 200, sitemap.xml 200, no inventory-sitemap (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-04: sitemap.xml WAF-blocked this run; fell back to recheck VDPs (existing VINs only). Consider browser mode for full NEW-inventory discovery next run. | 2026-09-06: sitemap.xml WAF-blocked again; server mode reaches recheck VDPs only. Full NEW-inventory discovery needs the browser: SRP /inventory/?model=X&dealername=nissan of irvine, price-ascending. Specials are JS-rendered, unreadable server-side. Watch banner-vs-disclaimer DAS mismatches ($2,995 headline vs $4,995/$5,495 fine print, 2 seen this run) - always record the disclosure figure. Consider flipping fetch to 'browser'. | 2026-09-20: FLIPPED fetch server -> browser. sitemap.xml WAF-blocked for the THIRD run running, so server mode reaches only re-check vehicle pages and discovers no new inventory. Specials are JS-rendered and unreadable server-side. Use the live SRP /inventory/?model=X&dealername=nissan of irvine, price-ascending

competitors.name: Nissan of Tustin
competitors.notes: 403 all server fetch (probe 2026-08-15) | 2026-09-04: specials at /new-vehicles/new-vehicle-specials/ (readable). browser-jsfetch ok. | 2026-09-06: browser-srp works. Specials at /new-vehicles/new-vehicle-specials/. Runs 24-month leases where rivals run 36 - do not compare payments without effective-cost normalization. No purchase APR anywhere = verified_zero for finance. No Rogue lease this run.

competitors.name: Nissan of Costa Mesa
competitors.notes: WAF newly enabled 2026-09-04: server fetch now 403s (was server-fetchable 2026-08-15). Real inventory sitemap is /inventoryvdpsitemap.xml (found via /sitemap.xml index); the old /inventory-sitemap.xml intermittently returns a cookie-shell HTML. Browser-jsfetch works. | 2026-09-06: /inventoryvdpsitemap.xml is STALE (357 of 358 urls 'Sentra') - do NOT trust it, use the live SRP instead. SRP shows MSRP only, real discount is gated behind a lead form, so its prices are not comparable to rivals' discounted advertised prices - caveat any price ranking. Trim strings gained drivetrain suffixes ('SV' -> 'SV FWD') without any payment change; offer keys are trim-normalized so this no longer reads as pulled+new.

competitors.name: Nissan of Orange
competitors.notes: TLS handshake rejected server-side (TLSV1_ALERT_PROTOCOL_VERSION, probe 2026-08-15); browser only | 2026-09-04: /specials/ renders readable text w/ VIN-level disclaimers (not banner images). Watch banner-vs-disclaimer $ mismatches (Rogue SV $209 headline vs $199 fine print, same VIN). | 2026-09-06: multi-store SRP, MUST filter to the Nissan Of Orange location facet. /specials/ renders readable text with VIN-level disclaimers. CONFIRMED banner-vs-disclaimer mismatch on Rogue VIN 5N1BT3BA5TC832343 (banner $209/$6,185 DAS vs disclosure $199/$7,705 DAS) - record the disclosure. Delistings here surface as SOFT REDIRECTS (HTTP 200 retitled to the SRP), not 404s.
